A new chapter begins in SPIDER-MAN: Brand New Day (2026).

Following the events that reshaped Peter Parker’s life, Spider-Man returns in a fresh story that explores identity, responsibility, and what it truly means to start over. As new threats emerge and old ones resurface, Peter must navigate a world where everything has changed.

Starring Tom Holland, this next installment in the Spider-Man saga expands the Marvel universe with new challenges, powerful enemies, and a deeper look into Peter Parker’s journey as the iconic web-slinger.
